independentSignatureVerification.verifier: Node.js crypto Ed25519 with independent NEP-413 Borsh encoding

limitations: Three samples per arm establish neither tail percentiles nor a latency guarantee.
Sequential arms include provider scheduling and network variation; small differences cannot establish causality.
Fresh wallets do not guarantee cold Workers. Worker cold starts were not controlled.
Invocation wall time can include background work and is not browser response time.
Nested spans overlap. Protocol spans include transport; zero Worker clock spans do not prove zero CPU.
Existing bound-root counters cover six D1 calls, not all database work in registration.

Console HTTP counts exclude scheduled events without a request path. The baseline Console observer emitted no records, so its request counts and invocation versions are unavailable. Its assigned version was guarded before and after the run.
The combined request retains fresh authentication and environment reads. It removes a Console HTTP request, not a D1 query.
Requested APAC placement does not prove physical colocation.

cleanup.finalActivationProbePolicy: Final activation may create new temporary probe registrations. Their normal leases remain intact; they were not bypassed or deleted.

decision.latencyConclusion: No meaningful full-flow latency improvement established by these three sequential samples per arm. Setup ranges overlap and the restored baseline setup median is lower than the candidate.
decision.verifiedChange: Fresh Console calls per wallet decrease from ten in the restored control to nine in the candidate. Both underlying authentication and active-environment reads remain.
decision.target: Registration to first independently verified NEAR signature below 3–4 seconds remains unmet.
decision.next: Trace and consolidate the duplicate NEAR warm-session status read within one operation, preserving fresh checks for independent operations and signing prepare.
